payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear comparison of single-system performance against system combination performance, highlighting improvements in word error rates (WER).

claims.text: The single-system achieved a WER of 41.6% on DEV and 43.2% on EVAL, which is a significant improvement over previous single-system results without system combination.
The single-system performance is better than the previously published top-line results of 45.1% and 47.3% WER on DEV and EVAL, respectively, which used a larger training dataset.
The proposed single-system shows a 16% relative WER reduction on DEV compared to a system from BIBREF12, indicating its competitive edge over system combinations.
